name: Measure updated Nix hashes
command:
set +e
"$HOME/.nix-profile/bin/nix" --extra-experimental-features 'nix-command flakes' --option sandbox false build .#server.pnpmDeps --no-link -L
server_status=$?
"$HOME/.nix-profile/bin/nix" --extra-experimental-features 'nix-command flakes' --option sandbox false build .#unwrapped.pnpmDeps --no-link -L
desktop_status=$?
printf '\nDependency checks: server=%s desktop=%s\n' "$server_status" "$desktop_status"
if [ "$server_status" -ne 0 ] || [ "$desktop_status" -ne 0 ]; then exit 1; fi
